issues.description: The problem statement and the template define Course.instructor as a String (and show initializer usage with a String), but the solution implementation declares Course.instructor as [String]. Additionally, the solution's Client creates a Course by passing a String for the instructor while the solution's Course initializer expects [String]. This mismatch (String vs [String]) is a structural inconsistency that will cause compilation errors and confuse students about the intended type for the instructor property.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the instructor type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to use instructor: String (update Course.instructor and its initializer to String) so it matches the problem statement and template; adjust any code that treats instructor as an array. Alternatively, if multiple instructors were intended, update the problem statement and the template to declare instructor as [String] and change Client.swift to pass an array of strings (e.g. ["Matthias", "Patrick", "Felix"]). Ensure all usages/print statements format the instructor(s) accordingly.

issues.description: The property 'instructor' is described in the problem statement and declared in the template as a String, but the solution implements it as an array of String ([String]). This type/name divergence for the same conceptual property ('instructor' of a Course) creates a mapping confusion: students expect and are instructed to pass a single String (e.g. "Matthias, Patrick, and Felix"), while the solution's Course API requires an array. This inconsistency increases extraneous cognitive load and may cause compilation or runtime mismatches when following the exercise instructions or comparing with the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'instructor' property consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution implementation to use instructor: String (and adjust the initializer and any prints) to match the problem statement and template. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to require instructor: [String] and change client code to pass an array of instructor names; choose one consistent representation and apply it throughout.
